units.rawText: Become the most perfect child... That's what Neumann told me. I've always learned from the data Neumann and the others input for me... That data built my basic Neural Cloud. It's my core.

units.rawText: But to become a perfect child, just learning from data isn't enough. I have to experience things and understand that data for myself, so I can give everyone better references.

units.rawText: So I want to use this body to travel to every corner of Magrasea and record data... Professor, will you come explore Magrasea with me?
